capabilities: display a progress bar in the status bar that fills as the note's word count grows
set a default word goal applied to all files
set per-file goals via a frontmatter property with a configurable key
turn the bar green when the goal is reached
extras: The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian shows a plain word count but no visual indicator of progress toward a writing goal.
summary: Status bar plugin that shows a miniature progress bar tracking the current note's word count against a set goal.
